children: Binance Wallet announced on X that Prediction Markets can now be accessed through the Binance App and Binance Wallet Web. In the Binance App, users can navigate to Exchange, then Markets, and select Prediction, or go to Wallet, then Home, then Prediction, and choose View more. On the web, the path is Binance Web, then Trade, then Prediction, or Binance Wallet Web, then Prediction. The announcement states that Prediction Markets are available only to users in eligible regions and may not be available to all users. No additional details were provided about supported products, timing, or regional availability beyond the eligibility restriction.

title: Binance Wallet Adds Access to Prediction Markets on App and Web
